mandate_origin: 도훈 직접 명령 2026-05-12 KST: 'PG2 강화 path PD30 raw + AR threshold + M4 overlay 결합 backtest 병렬 진행'
scope_interpretation: Pure overlay sleeve-level scaling (L-281 STR_1715_AR_threshold_overlay_PG2 패러다임). KR_EQUITY_alloc_t = 0.55 × β_t, CASH = 0.045 + 0.55 × (1-β_t), TSMOM/KR_10Y unchanged. Stock-level top20 softmax (z_composite) 그대로 보존.
delta_table_correction_note: Original delta_vs_pd30_raw.csv had MDD sign convention bug — overlay variants stored MDD as positive magnitude (PerformanceAnalytics maxDrawdown convention) while PD30_C baseline stored as negative. Computed delta_MDD_pp showed -42pp (wrong). Corrected file: delta_vs_pd30_raw_corrected.csv uses unified positive-magnitude convention; true delta_MDD_pp = -3.71pp (improvement). See fix_delta_table_pd36.R.

key_finding_summary.headline_primary_MULT: PD36 MULT overlay vs PD30 raw: SR -0.0341 (1.0081 -> 0.974), CAGR -2.32pp (16.89% -> 14.57%), MDD -3.71pp IMPROVEMENT (22.94% -> 19.23%), CVaR95 +1.17pp IMPROVEMENT (-8.79% -> -7.62%). TO +0.31 (cost increase from sleeve rebalance during de-risk periods).
key_finding_summary.tradeoff_interpretation: Overlay enforces de-risk in 39.7% of post-2004 months (mean beta_MULT=0.84). Sacrifices upside in normal regimes (-2.32pp CAGR) for tail-risk reduction (-3.71pp MDD, +1.17pp CVaR95). Risk-adjusted return (SR) marginally worse (-0.034) because volatility reduction is less than mean reduction in 296m sample.
key_finding_summary.vs_s4_v2_gap: MULT SR 0.974 vs S4 v2 SR 1.7877 = gap 0.81. S4 v2 uses STR_1715 Iter31 alpha (NOT z_composite) with same M4/AR overlay. Differences attributable to: (1) alpha source: STR_1715 Iter31 4F Consensus + 3-axis Defense top20 vs PD30 z_composite (0.818 pd27 + 0.182 pd24) — different stock selection, (2) S4 v2 window 255m vs PD36 295m — overlay effect attenuated by 31m pre-2004 passthrough segment, (3) sleeve composition: S4 v2 50/25/20/5 vs PD30 55/22.5/18/4.5 — marginal.
key_finding_summary.dm_test_significance: All 3 variants statistically DIFFERENT from PD30 raw at 5% (p < 0.05). Negative mean diff (overlay underperforms PD30 raw on average) — overlay protects MDD/CVaR but costs SR in this 296m sample dominated by bull markets.
key_finding_summary.implication_for_admit_strict_cycle: PD36 evidence suggests Overlay coupling does NOT improve SR vs PD30 raw in this measurement window. Tail-risk protection (MDD -3.71pp, CVaR95 +1.17pp) confirmed but at cost of -0.034 SR. Strict admit cycle (WT-D20260512_001) needs to evaluate: (a) MDD-priority weighting (도훈 잔여 P0 = MDD -7.05pp gap), (b) regime-conditional alpha selection (overlay activated only in identified stress periods, NOT continuous), (c) AR/M4 calibration revisit (current thresholds may be over-conservative).
